## Projects

**Customer Segmentation with RFM Analysis** — *Python, scikit-learn, Plotly*

**Sales Forecasting Dashboard** — *Python, time series, Plotly*
Built a 90-day sales forecasting pipeline with decomposition (trend, weekly seasonality, residual) and an 80% confidence band. Produced an interactive dashboard to surface daily, weekly, and peak-day insights.

**Power BI Dashboard — Sales Analysis** — *Power BI, Business Analytics*
An interactive business dashboard analysing sales trends and KPIs across multiple dimensions.

**BERT vs. Generative AI for Business Applications** — *Python, NLP, Deep Learning*
Fine-tuned BERT on Rotten Tomatoes reviews and compared with Llama 3.1 zero-shot and few-shot prompting for sentiment analysis.

**3XM Data Analytics Project** — *Python, Data Analytics, Machine Learning*
Applied two machine learning algorithms to develop a complete business analytics pipeline for 3XM Solutions, specialising in premium product analytics.
